title: ON THE FAIRNESS OF Fake DATA IN LEGAL AI
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The discussion focuses on fairness in legal AI, using the general concept of 'protected class' and 'race' as a specific example, without mentioning or analyzing religion.
